title: Pipelines | A deal can’t be moved to another pipeline (record page, Mass Update, API)
label: BUG

panels.caption: TAVI — deal "QA W2 PL Standard": "Change pipeline" to pipeline "1" confirmed; the PATCH answered 422 and the dialog stays open with no message. The deal is still in "Standard (Default)".
Zoho — Setup › Customization › Pipelines. This org has only the default sales process, so moving a deal between pipelines could not be shown here.

rows: Move a deal to another pipeline from the record page
Not checked live: this Zoho org has no second pipeline (the Pipelines page offers "Create New Pipeline")
Confirm sends PATCH → 422 "Invalid value for: Pipeline"; the dialog stays open and shows no message
Move by Mass Update or the API

Mass Update → 422 "‘640e03a4…’ is not one of the allowed values (Standard (Standard))"; API PATCH, and even create with the layout’s own pipeline id → 422. Only the text "Standard (Standard)" is accepted
